integrity: The group normal form and truncated-unit semidirect decomposition are credited to the 2021 primary literature; the claimed contribution consists of exact conjugacy and element-order formulas and their coprime norm argument. Finite computations corroborate but do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact counts apply to standard finite-dimensional nilpotent cyclic left Leibniz algebras over finite fields only; not other cyclic types, semilinear automorphisms or arbitrary fields. Publication priority beyond inspected sources is not established.
title: Conjugacy and element-order census for automorphisms of cyclic nilpotent Leibniz algebras
